{\fad(1300,0)}Navy HQ

name: Garp
text: The Dark King, Silvers Rayleigh, huh?

name: Marine
text: It would appear the others haven't noticed, and think he's just a normal old guy.

name: Garp
text: They're gonna sell the Dark King in the Human Auction, huh?
{\fad(1000,1000)}The Auction House Incident

name: Marine
text: If he's the real deal, then this is a really bad situation...

name: Marine
text: Although my subordinates can't be 100% sure...

name: Garp
text: Tea!

name: Marine
text: Uh, right.

name: Marine
text: What should we do, vice-admiral? Should I report this to Fleet Admiral Sengoku?

name: Garp
text: Nah, I'll handle this myself. Don't tell anyone else, not even Sengoku!

name: Garp
text: Make sure to tell your subordinates!

name: Marine
text: But if it really is him...

name: Garp
text: It's him. No doubt about that.

name: Garp
text: I hear some reports about the guy from time to time.

name: Garp
text: I'd say he's probably ended up losing his freedom in a gamble.

name: Garp
text: He might be an old man, but if we try to take on Rayleigh unprepared,

name: Garp
text: I'd say we'd probably lose countless soldiers in the attempt.

name: Garp
text: It's especially dangerous right now.

name: Garp
text: You think the Navy can handle two legends at the same time?!
Grove 1\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\N\NHuman Auction Site

name: Slave-trader
text: Well then, everyone! Thank you for your patience!

name: Slave-trader
text: In a moment, the 1st grove's monthly tradition...

name: Slave-trader
text: the Great Human Auction, shall commence!

name: Slave-trader
text: Our host, of course, is this man!

name: Slave-trader
text: The walking super bazaar...

name: Slave-trader
text: Mr. Disco!

name: Disco
text: Good day, everyone! This time, we've got quite an excellent selection of slaves for you!

name: Disco
text: You are all lucky! We've got a spectacular deluxe item for later in the show!

name: Disco
text: The only thing on my mind is making sure everyone here leaves with the slave they've been waiting for!

name: Disco
text: Well, then, let us start the auction!

name: Slave-trader
text: Prepare numbers 2 and 3.

name: Slave-trader 2
text: Understood!

name: Disco
text: Entry #1: from Toroa in West Blue!

name: Disco
text: A master of instruments from a musician family!

name: Disco
text: A pirate standing proud and tall!

name: Disco
text: With his instrument, he'll play any music you want,

name: Disco
text: a human music box!

name: Disco
text: Give him a mop, and he will clean up any filth perfectly!

name: Disco
text: He is also a fantastic wine maker!

name: Disco
text: A 25 year old human male, a perfect working age!

name: Disco
text: 192 cm, 130 kg, name: Byron!

name: Disco
text: We will start off the bidding with the special starting price of 480 thousand belly!

name: Disco
text: Well, then, raise your plate if you wish to place a bid!

name: Disco
text: Number 82 makes a bid of 500 thousand belly!

name: Disco
text: We have 600 thousand from number 7! Anyone else?!

name: Disco
text: Sold, for 600 thousand belly!
Note: Human trade

name: Sanji
text: What's this, Duval?

name: Sanji
text: This disgusting list?

name: Duval
text: It's the market prices.

name: Sanji
text: Market prices?

name: Sanji
text: Basic auction minimum prices...

name: Sanji
text: Humans, 500 thousand belly.

name: Sanji
text: Male giants are 50 million belly...

name: Sanji
text: What? Female mermen are sold for 70 million belly?!

name: Duval
text: You understand why everyone tries to catch mermaids now, right?

name: Duval
text: The value is something else!

name: Duval
text: You can do whatever you want to them once you've bought them...

name: Duval
text: but they usually end up in some rich person's aquarium.

name: Duval
text: They have to live out their lives as decorations in small tanks.

name: Sanji
text: What're you trying to say, damn you?!

name: Duval
text: Now that I think about it though, you can hardly call that "living" at all.

name: Sanji
text: If that's what you think, then hurry up and find her!

name: Rider
text: We've covered all the slave-traders stationed in the 20's!

name: Luffy
text: Hurry up and go into the air!

name: Rider
text: Don't make it sound so easy!

name: Rider
text: This ain't a bird, you know, it's gotta pick up speed first!

name: Luffy
text: Camie! Where are you?!

name: Slave-trader
text: This is what's getting to me!
{\fad(1600,0)}Kidnapping team "Coffee Monkeys"

name: Slave-trader
text: It was a giant, damn it! It was easy enough to catch the guy sleeping...

name: Slave-trader
text: but do you have any idea how hard it was to carry'im?!

name: Slave-trader
text: Of course, you'd think we'd gotten the big draw this time, right?

name: Slave-trader
text: That's how it usually is, right?

name: Slave-trader
text: But then some guy went and brought a freakin' mermaid to the auction house!

name: Slave-trader
text: Who wouldn't get drunk when somethin' like that happens?

name: Usopp
text: Hang on! Who was that?

name: Rider
text: This is unit 5, to all Rosy Life Riders!

name: Rider
text: Can you hear me? The guy who took the mermaid is Peterman!

name: Rider
text: The place they took her to was the auction in Grove 1!

name: Rider 2
text: Did you say it was Peterman?

name: Luffy
text: Did you find it out?

name: Rider 2
text: Yeah, let's fly!

name: Brook
text: This is a little too fast! I am scared!

name: Franky
text: She hasn't been sold already, has she?

name: Nami
text: Hurry!

name: Rider
text: Grove 1 should be nearby! Leave it to me!

name: Rider 2
text: We'll head towards the Auction House!

name: Hachi
text: You figured out where she is? Thank god!

name: Pappagg
text: Camie!

name: Luffy
text: Hurry!

name: Zoro
text: I'd like to return to the ship, but where's the number 1 tree?

name: Bounty-hunter
text: I'll tell you!

name: Disco
text: Well, well, let us keep going! Here is entry #6!

name: Disco
text: A 10-pack of male human workers!

name: Duval
text: This is the Head, calling all men! Get me some info on today's auction!

name: Rider
text: It started at 4 o'clock, and it's been going for 30 minutes already!

name: Sanji
text: Hey, will this really be alright?

name: Duval
text: No problem at all!

name: Duval
text: A mermaid would certainly be the main event, so they'll save her for the end!

name: Duval
text: We'll make it!

name: Sanji
text: Anyway, take the fastest route! This thing is slower than the Flying Fish!

name: Duval
text: Like I said, calm down, Master Black Leg!

name: Duval
text: I'm the Head of this team! Did you see me change my course after we learned the mermaid's location?

name: Sanji
text: Uh, no...

name: Duval
text: That's because...

name: Duval
text: I've been heading to Grove 1 from the beginning!

name: Duval
text: Look ahead! That's Grove 1! I am the Head, so I got here before everyone else!

name: Sanji
text: Are you serious?

name: Sanji
text: This must be the intuition of a professional!

name: Rider
text: We've arrived, Reindeer-san!

name: Chopper
text: Thank you. Huh?

name: Chopper
text: Oh, Sanji!

name: Sanji
text: You lost, didn't you?!

name: Rider
text: Be careful!

name: Franky
text: Yeah! Thanks a lot!

name: Franky
text: What's with this guy?

name: Disco
text: 200 thousand belly! Anyone else?

name: Disco
text: Sold!

name: Franky
text: Is this it?

name: Sanji
text: Like I said, why can't you give her back?!

name: Sanji
text: I'm telling you that Camie-chan is not for sale!

name: Slave-trader
text: You're the one who's out of line here!

name: Slave-trader
text: If you don't drop it soon, I can take legal countermeasures!

name: Slave-trader
text: You're disturbing our business!

name: Franky
text: Those guys...!

name: Sanji
text: What do you mean, "business", you damn bastard?!

name: Sanji
text: Do you think I'll accept a business like this in this world?!

name: Slave-trader
text: A lawless pirate like yourself has no right to lecture me about morality!

name: Nami
text: Slave-trading is a worldwide taboo! How much did you pay the government?

name: Slave-trader
text: What an ill-mannered accusation...

name: Slave-trader
text: But I suppose you're right!

name: Slave-trader
text: When talking to the government or marines,

name: Slave-trader
text: it seems that terms like "slave-trading" are hard for them comprehend.

name: Slave-trader
text: It's as if they have no idea that this business of ours exists!

name: Sanji
text: How ridiculous... So the whole system is crooked, then?!

name: Nami
text: How can the government tolerate this?!

name: Slave-trader
text: So, could you please...

name: Franky
text: This is annoying!

name: Franky
text: We're sure the mermaid is in there, so let's just break her out!

name: Franky
text: {\fad(150,150)}Weapons...

name: Hachi
text: No! There are Celestial Dragons inside!

name: Hachi
text: And if Camie has been brought here, then she's probably got a neck ring already!

name: Chopper
text: That exploding thing?!

name: Chopper
text: Then, we can't just get her out?

name: Slave-trader
text: If you'd please leave then.

name: Sanji
text: Why, you...!

name: Chopper
text: No, Sanji!

name: Sanji
text: Let me go, Chopper!

name: Chopper
text: I can't, Sanji!

name: Sanji
text: Damn it...

name: Sanji
text: If the guy won't listen, then...!

name: Franky
text: Hey, Girlie! Where are you going?

name: Chopper
text: I said calm down, Sanji!

name: Nami
text: If we can't hurt them, then we'll just play by their rules to get Camie back!
{\fad(800,0)}Backstage

name: Slave-trader 1
text: Bring out numbers 15 and 16.

name: Slave-trader 2
text: Understood.

name: Pirate
text: Please stop!

name: Pirate
text: I don't want to! I'd rather stay in the cell!

name: Pirate
text: I don't wanna be a slave!

name: Pirate
text: Help me, please! Help!

name: Slave-trader
text: Give him a tranquilizer.

name: Pirate
text: Call the Navy! Please!

name: Pirate
text: Don't sell me, please!

name: Camie
text: Hacchin... Save me!

name: Pirate
text: {\fad(0,1000)}Noooooo!

name: Pirate 2
text: Chief, I think that's the Straw Hat crew.

name: Kid
text: The Straw Hats' captain isn't there...

name: Kid
text: I was hoping to see just how dumb he was myself...

name: Disco
text: Now, things are heating up, on this Grand Human Auction!

name: Disco
text: Our next entry is an instant purchase, for sure!

name: Disco
text: Entry number 15 is a knockout female slave!

name: Disco
text: Please observe the miraculous proportions of this 20 year old dancer, Pascia!

name: Disco
text: She's one of today's big draws!

name: Disco
text: Her marvelous dancing figure is sure to impress even the heavens!

name: Nami
text: We've got loads of treasure stored on the ship.

name: Nami
text: It's at least 200 million in all...

name: Nami
text: What's the going price for a mermaid?

name: Hachi
text: If you have that much, then it should be enough, but I can't repay that!

name: Nami
text: What, Hachi? Are you Camie's guardian or something?

name: Hachi
text: It's not like that...

name: Nami
text: If it's to get our friend back, then I don't care how much we have to pay!

name: Nami
text: Everyone agrees, right?

name: Chopper
text: Of course! This isn't about money!

name: Pappagg
text: Thanks a lot... you guys...

name: Pappagg
text: I'll never forget this...!

name: Sanji
text: That's the Nami-san I love!

name: Franky
text: Shut up and come on.

name: Luffy
text: Hurry! Hurry!

name: Rider
text: I get it!

name: Luffy
text: Hurry to Grove 1!

name: Zoro
text: So this is Grove 2, huh?

name: Zoro
text: Then it's the next one, right?

name: Usopp
text: Is everyone there yet?

name: Man
text: Extra! Extra!

name: Apoo
text: Is the World Government out of its mind?

name: Pirate
text: If they really do this, then...!

name: Pirate 2
text: Captain, this could mean trouble!

name: Drake
text: Is that how it is?

name: Pirate
text: Is something wrong, Captain Drake?

name: Drake
text: I understand now...

name: Drake
text: Seeing how close this island is to Navy HQ...

name: Drake
text: I thought it was strange that there were so few marines around.

name: Pirate
text: What has happened?

name: Drake
text: It's been decided that Fire Fist Ace, commander of Whitebeard's second division, is set to be executed!

name: Pirate
text: If they do that, then Whitebeard is sure to make a move!

name: Drake
text: There's gonna be a war!

name: Disco
text: Entry #15!

name: Disco
text: The beautiful dancer, Pascia!

name: Disco
text: With a splendid starting bid of 800 thousand belly,

name: Disco
text: the bid has risen to an amazing 7 million 200 thousand belly!

name: Charlos
text: Ah... We have finally arrived.

name: Disco
text: Well well, things are heating up now...

name: Disco
text: What will be the next item up for bid?!

name: Charlos
text: Good, the auction is still going.

name: Servant
text: However they're almost done.

name: Charlos
text: This one is truly useless!

name: Charlos
text: Hey! Have this one sold off too! I don't want him anymore.

name: Servant
text: I'll do the paperwork right away.

name: Chopper
text: A Celestial Dragon...

name: Nami
text: Another one showed up... One of the World Nobles...

name: Sanji
text: Those guys that can call an admiral from the Navy if we attack them, huh?

name: Charlos
text: I would like a mermaid... Are they gonna sell one today?

name: Servant
text: It seems that mermaids are quite difficult to catch...

name: Servant
text: so I doubt they've got one this time.

name: Slave-trader
text: Oh, my! Saint Charlos!

name: Charlos
text: Hurry and take me to my seat!

name: Slave-trader
text: Yes, right away, Sir!

name: Sharlia
text: So, you are finally here, big brother Charlos?

name: Disco
text: Well then, it seems we're ready...

name: Disco
text: Entry #16 is...

name: Disco
text: Can you believe it?! A pirate captain!

name: Disco
text: A wanted man with a bounty of 17 million belly! His name is Lacuba!

name: Disco
text: He is a pirate famous for his delicate, intricate planning! His well built body is also worthy of note.

name: Disco
text: He'd make an excellent transport, hard worker, or sandbag!

name: Disco
text: A practical choice if I ever saw one!

name: Disco
text: Now then...!

name: Disco
text: Don't tell me, he...?!

name: Man 1
text: He collapsed! What's going on?!

name: Man 2
text: I saw blood!

name: Disco
text: Hey! Hurry up and pull the curtains!

name: Nami
text: What just happened?

name: Sanji
text: He bit his tongue.

name: Sanji
text: He decided that he didn't want to live his life as a slave...

name: Sanji
text: and figured it would be better to just die right now.

name: Sanji
text: I suppose that's actually a logical choice.

name: Franky
text: Aren't they going to bring out the mermaid soon?

name: Chopper
text: I'm sure Camie is really scared...

name: Nami
text: Just hang in there a little longer...

name: Nami
text: We're going to save you!

name: Nami
text: Fortunately, we have the treasure from Thriller Bark!

name: Pappagg
text: Thanks a lot, you guys...

name: Slave-trader
text: This is no good...

name: Disco
text: God damn it! We can't sell him now... That idiot!

name: Disco
text: The mermaid is up next, right?

name: Slave-trader
text: Yes. We're ready to get her whenever you want us to.

name: Disco
text: Alright!

name: Disco
text: Get her out, now!

name: Slave-trader
text: Yes!

name: Disco
text: Well then, about #16!

name: Disco
text: It would appear that the pirate Lacuba got a little nervous... He had a nosebleed, and collapsed.

name: Disco
text: We'll put him up for sale again later.

name: Disco
text: However, everyone...!

name: Disco
text: The next item we're going to bring out now...

name: Disco
text: is a super deluxe-item that's sure to make you forget all about this trouble!

name: Disco
text: Countless people have tried to capture one...

name: Disco
text: Please look at this silhouette!

name: Man
text: Could it be...?!

name: Disco
text: An introduction should not be necessary... Just have a look with your own eyes!

name: Disco
text: Thank you for your patience! Well then, here it comes!

name: Disco
text: Have a good look at this!

name: Disco
text: Straight from Fishman Island...

name: Disco
text: Camie, the mermaid!!!

name: Man
text: It's real! A young mermaid!

name: Camie
text: Hacchin and the others! They're here to save me!

name: Hachi
text: Camie! They've brought out Camie!

name: Nami
text: Alright, we're gonna take her back!

name: Nami
text: We've got 200 million after all!

name: Pappagg
text: Camie!

name: Charlos
text: Finally! A mermaid! They're selling a mermaid!

name: Charlos
text: Five hundred million!!

name: Charlos
text: I'll buy it for 500 million belly!

name: Man 2
text: No use... We can't beat that...

name: Nami
text: What's that? We don't have that much!

name: Rosward
text: You've gone and wasted our money again.

name: Rosward
text: You already have piranhas in your fish tank, do you not?

name: Charlos
text: I'd like too see them try and chase after her...

name: Charlos
text: Mermaids are the fastest sea-creatures in the world.

name: Camie
text: I can't hear the voices outside...

name: Camie
text: Get me out of here, Hacchin!

name: Disco
text: It would appear that the audience has been rendered speechless...

name: Disco
text: Well, does anyone want to make a higher bid than 500 million?

name: Chopper
text: There's gotta be something we can do...

name: Chopper
text: Hey, Sanji?

name: Chopper
text: Nami?

name: Chopper
text: This can't be happening! They can't take our friend away just because we don't have enough money!

name: Sanji
text: This is bad... We never considered this possibility...

name: Sanji
text: If we can't get her back with money, then the situation has gotten even worse!

name: Disco
text: If not, then this auction will be quite a short one!

name: Hachi
text: Now that it's come to this, I might as well just take her back by force and run off to the sea!

name: Pappagg
text: Don't be ridiculous! What about the neck-ring?

name: Pappagg
text: You'd just blow her up!

name: Hachi
text: Then I just have to get the key to that ring somehow...

name: Disco
text: That's enough time!

name: Charlos
text: I did it!

name: Kid
text: It's like a symbol of how messed up the world is...

name: Kid
text: I've seen enough of this farce. We're leaving.

name: Disco
text: Well then, thank you for your attention up until now.

name: Disco
text: The main prize this time, the mermaid Camie...

name: Disco
text: goes to the World Noble, Saint Charlos for the price of 500 million belly...

name: Disco
text: It's...

name: Kid
text: What?!

name: Disco
text: ...a deal!

name: Disco
text: What?!

name: Rosward
text: How noisy.

name: Sanji
text: Luffy!

name: Luffy
text: What the heck?! Couldn't you land any better than that?!

name: Rider
text: No way! It's a Flying Fish, you know!

name: Rider
text: And it was you who told me to crash into the building!

name: Zoro
text: Anyway, you told me to get on...

name: Zoro
text: But why were you in such a hurry to get back to the Sunny anyway?

name: Zoro
text: Where are we?

name: Chopper
text: Zoro, too?

name: Zoro
text: You guys!

name: Kid
text: Hey, that's Straw Hat Luffy!

name: Man
text: What's with those guys? Who are they?

name: Luffy
text: Oh! Camie!

name: Camie
text: Luffy-chin!

name: Luffy
text: Camie! I looked for you!

name: Luffy
text: Thank God!

name: Hachi
text: Wait a second, Straw Hat! What are you doing?

name: Luffy
text: What do you mean?! Camie's right there!

name: Hachi
text: She's there, but she's got an exploding neck-ring attached! So you can't just take her!

name: Hachi
text: Besides, the Celestial Dragons are here!

name: Luffy
text: Like I care!

name: Man 2
text: He's a pirate!

name: Luffy
text: Camie!

name: Hachi
text: Just stop already!

name: Woman
text: A fishman!

name: Man
text: That's disgusting!

name: Man 2
text: What's a fishman doing here?

name: Man 3
text: You octopus monster!

name: Luffy
text: I'm gonna save you right now, Camie!

name: Disco
text: Get him!

name: Luffy
text: Damn you! Camie isn't for sale!

name: Disco
text: Don't let him get any closer to the stage!

name: Man
text: What's a fishman doing on land?

name: Woman
text: No, don't get any closer! It's creepy!

name: Man
text: Hey, staff! Hurry up and restrain him!

name: Woman
text: No, don't come here!

name: Man
text: Go back to the sea, you monster!

name: Man 2
text: Yeah, that's right!

name: Man 3
text: Get off this island!

name: Man 4
text: Get lost!

name: Pappagg
text: Hachi! Hurry up and escape!

name: Pappagg
text: You're the one who's in trouble now!

name: Hachi
text: I'm fine! What about Camie?

name: Sanji
text: What's going on here?

name: Nami
text: It's just like Robin said...

name: Nami
text: Mermen and fishmen are discriminated against on this island!

name: Chopper
text: Discriminated against...?

name: Chopper
text: Even Camie and Hachi?!

name: Charlos
text: I hit it! I shot a fishman!

name: Nami
text: Hachi!

name: Woman
text: I'm glad he shot it!

name: Woman
text: I was afraid that if it came any closer, we might get infected by it!

name: Man
text: He was definitely trying to cause some trouble... After all, they've only got the brains of a fish!

name: Charlos
text: Father, please look! I caught a fishman!

name: Charlos
text: I caught it myself, so it's for free!

name: Charlos
text: Free! Free! An octopus for free!

name: Charlos
text: I got it, I got it!

name: Charlos
text: An octopus-slave for free! Free!

name: Hachi
text: W... Wait... Please...

name: Hachi
text: Straw Hat...

name: Hachi
text: You can't... get upset...\NI was just careless, that's all...

name: Hachi
text: You promised that... even if someone was shot right before your eyes...

name: Hachi
text: you wouldn't lay a hand on the Celestial Dragons, right?!

name: Hachi
text: After all, I used to be a pirate...

name: Hachi
text: I did so many awful things, so...

name: Hachi
text: I had this coming...

name: Hachi
text: Sorry...

name: Hachi
text: I never wanted this to happen...

name: Hachi
text: I just wanted... to make up for all the things I did to Nami...!

name: Hachi
text: I was trying to help you, but...

name: Hachi
text: As always...

name: Hachi
text: I just screw up no matter what I do...!

name: Hachi
text: I really am... clumsy after all...

name: Nami
text: Hachi...

name: Hachi
text: In the end... I just caused you trouble...!

name: Hachi
text: I'm sorry!

name: Hachi
text: I'm so sorry!

name: Charlos
text: Damn fish!

name: Charlos
